families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground: Tideline's warm-stone canvas by day, the abyss by night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Floating layers (menus, dialogs, drawers) and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, table header rows, empty-state wells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: table rules, gridlines, range tracks.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The 2px rule across the top of every bay. The only heavy line; softer than ink by night so the rails do not glare.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, readouts, body copy.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, axis text, timestamps (≥ 4.5:1). Tideline's text-subtle by day, so secondary text visibly recedes from ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tideline's lagoon teal: the one interactive colour. Primary keys, links, current nav, focus.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active chips, nav hover. Text on it is ink or accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: solid 2px, 2px offset.

tokens.name: annotation
tokens.usage: Chart annotations: thresholds such as the bleaching MMM + 1 °C line. Never text, never status.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Live, confirmed, good change. Always with a word or sign.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a confirmed or live chip.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Failed, rejected, destructive. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a rejected or failed chip.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Stale data, pending changes, sign-off outstanding.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a pending or stale chip.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (Tideline's Okabe–Ito set): one per buoy.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (Tideline's Okabe–Ito set): one per buoy.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (Tideline's Okabe–Ito set): one per buoy.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (Tideline's Okabe–Ito set): one per buoy.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (Tideline's Okabe–Ito set): one per buoy.

tokens.name: series-temp
tokens.usage: Water temperature, wherever it is plotted (Tideline data-temp).

tokens.name: series-turb
tokens.usage: Turbidity, wherever it is plotted (Tideline data-turb).

tokens.name: series-other
tokens.usage: Anything past the categorical set, grouped as Other.

tokens.name: seq-0
tokens.usage: Sequential scale: lagoon stepping in lightness, never a rainbow.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential scale: lagoon stepping in lightness, never a rainbow.

tokens.usage: Sequential scale: lagoon stepping in lightness, never a rainbow.

tokens.usage: Sequential scale: lagoon stepping in lightness, never a rainbow.
